rules.description: Checks that the percentage of deleted records does not exceed 0.1%.

Disabled for EPA_GHGRP_ParentCompanies_Ownership because EpaOrganizationOwnership stores non-numeric facility DCIDs in value, which triggers Sanity_SVObs_Value_NotANumber when ImportExecutor runs dc-import genmcf without --allow-non-numeric-obs-values.
